purpose: Canonical addendum to the merged Gemini/Antigravity coverage lock. It preserves one direct pre-manifest Antigravity analyzer-hardening proposition omitted from the 21-entry master ledger and binds it to its strongest current V4 descendant. Fold this entry into GEMINI-ANTIGRAVITY.json atomically when the planned ledger consolidation lands; do not drop it or keep both copies.

entry.literal_claim: Clip final evaluated agent-index margins to [-65000, 65000] so a hostile or buggy massive finite value cannot dominate mean-based seat/index analysis.
entry.best_form: Do not impose or clip to a guessed universal reward ceiling. Preserve strict finite-number validation, exact redundant-outcome consistency, and large legitimate engine margins. For untrusted ingestion, optionally require structured rewards or score+opponent_score instead of margin-only records, and optionally enforce a caller-authenticated positive absolute-margin bound. A bound rejects out-of-range records rather than clipping them. Derived reward/score subtraction is itself revalidated for finiteness so finite operands cannot overflow into an infinite margin.
entry.next_gate: Any default magnitude bound must be authenticated from the producing engine/data contract and shown not to reject legitimate current-engine outcomes. Until then the default remains unbounded finite input, while trusted callers may opt into structured-outcome enforcement and an authenticated reject-only margin bound.
